ValidationRule.description: Active projects cannot kick off more than a day in the future, more than 2 years in the past, or later today than the current UTC time.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Active'), NOT(ISBLANK(Kickoff_At__c)), OR( Kickoff_At__c > NOW() + 1, TODAY() - DATEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c) > 730, AND(DATEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c) = TODAY(), TIMEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c) > TIMENOW()) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Active project has an implausible Kickoff At.
